build_tensor_broadcast_shape: build a function that computes the broadcasted shape of two tensor dimension lists
compute_conv2d_output_shape: compute the output shape of a conv2d layer given input, weight, stride, padding, dilation, and groups
compute_max_pool2d_output_shape: compute the output shape of a max_pool2d operation given input, kernel_size, stride, padding, dilation, and ceil_mode
compute_matmul_output_shape: compute the output shape of a matmul operation between two tensors of arbitrary batch dimensions
compute_flatten_output_shape: compute the output shape of a flatten operation given input dimensions, start_dim, and end_dim
